offers_products.reason: Distributes third-party software and cloud/data center technology products from 100+ vendors; software distribution is the core business.

offers_services.reason: Main business is distribution; enablement, support and some services are secondary to reselling vendor software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to VARs, resellers and channel partners, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are IT resellers and VARs, buying software for resale to business and education end users.

recurring_revenue.reason: Resellers repeatedly order software licences and SaaS subscriptions and renewals from vendors; repeat channel purchasing.

cyclical_demand.reason: Software licences, security and cloud subscriptions are fairly essential and renewing, so not easily cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent software licence and subscription orders through resellers; individual orders are small relative to buyers' spending.

people_delivered.reason: Distributor of software products; value comes from vendor products and channel relationships, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly small and mid-sized resellers and VARs underserved by broadline distributors.

asset_heavy.reason: Software distributor needing little physical plant; growth comes via acquisitions and working capital, not fleets or networks.
